summary: Hiker got cliffed out on the side of Red Mountain in Garfield County for more than seven hours after down-climbing into steep terrain with loose rock and dirt and deciding it was too dangerous to continue. He called for rescue and was advised to use his cellphone light to signal down to the road so rescuers could get a visual on his position in the dark; a helicopter was used to bring him to safety.
responding_agency: Garfield County Search and Rescue; helicopter extraction (aircraft operator not reported)
notes: DATE APPROXIMATE: Unofficial Networks 2017-09-08 account (citing the Glenwood Springs Post Independent) places the incident over Labor Day weekend 2017 (Sat Sep 2 - Mon Sep 4); exact day unrecoverable, 2017-09-03 used as mid-weekend. Resolves the run-11/run-68 pending Red Mountain cliff-out lead. The Post Independent detailed account is unreachable via the browser (domain policy block), so no exact date could be pinned. Dedupe: no Garfield rows 2017-08-01 to 2017-10-01 and no prior Red Mountain Garfield County rows.
